body: Try our AI-powered service platform before you buy. You can set up AI agents and Copilot in your actual support workflows, then use live data to see exactly how much faster your team can scale.
14-day free trial. No credit card required.
Get 14 days of full access to our full AI-driven platform. No credit card or installation needed.
Access premium features in your plan, including ticketing, help center, AI agents, Copilot, and reporting. Test integrations and apps, and track performance with built-in analytics.
Accessing your trial takes only a few minutes. Complete the registration form for access to most features with no commitment or payment required. Cancel anytime.
Zendesk works in any browser with no installation required. You have access to free resources and chat support anytime.
Customer stories
“The reason that Zendesk is the right product is because it’s so user friendly. It’s been so easy to just basically set someone up for success from day one.”
Anastasia Parris
Marketing Operations Manager, Rain
Full agent workspace with real-time collaboration.
AI automation that routes and resolves tickets fast.
Custom dashboards for instant insights and tracking.
Centralized service portal for internal requests.
Automate routine tasks to speed employee support.
Real-time HR dashboards for performance tracking.
Explore every feature, compare plans side by side, and choose the option that best fits your needs today.

The free trial lasts for 14 days. No credit card is required to start, so you can explore the platform risk-free. If you need more time to test complex workflows, you can request a one-time extension through the admin dashboard. You can sign up for your free trial here and begin setting up your environment in minutes.
